rationale: Ahmad's work on AI-native hardware form factors at Midjourney—informed by his Vision Pro and hand-tracking background—could benefit from Dylan's founder-level technical curiosity and GTM expertise in scaling AI products. While their domains differ (hardware vs. edtech), Dylan's conviction that AI solves endemic scaling problems and his hands-on research approach offer a complementary perspective on how to position and validate new hardware categories in the market.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Dylan Bryan — Ahmad is pioneering AI-native hardware at Midjourney while Dylan brings GTM and AI product scaling experience from Casey AI; both think deeply about how AI solves broken systems.
